PATTERN: Ned runs the full Tutlio dev setup (Vite on 5555 + Vercel dev on 5556) in an external terminal before sessions start. When an API appears unreachable, it's always a proxy/config issue — not a missing server.

WHEN: Any time an API call returns 404 or the browser can't reach an endpoint — check proxy config and curl directly, don't attempt to start servers.

WHY: Ned interrupted mid-session when Claude issued a background Bash command to start Vercel dev — the server was already running. Starting a second instance would conflict.
